description_en: Queries the available periodic report IDs and period ranges for a specified product
description_zh: 查询指定商品的可用周期报告编号及周期范围
name: ListProductReports

parameters.help_en: The product code of the data product for which to query periodic reports. This must be consistent with the product code used when calling InvokeDataProduct. This parameter is required and allows only 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), or hyphens (-). Leading and trailing spaces are not trimmed. If this parameter is missing or incorrectly formatted, InvalidParameter.ProductCode is returned. The query is limited to reports belonging to the current Alibaba Cloud account. If no available reports exist, an empty Reports array is returned
parameters.help_zh: 要查询周期报告的数据产品商品编码，与 InvokeDataProduct 调用时使用的商品编码一致。必填，只允许 1～128 位 ASCII 字母、数字、点（.）、下划线（_）或短横线（-）；不去除首尾空格。缺失或格式不符时返回 InvalidParameter.ProductCode。查询限于当前云账号所属报告，没有可用报告时返回空 Reports 数组
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only the most recent active epoch report. If this parameter is omitted or set to false, the operation returns active reports within the last ten completed natural weeks in UTC+8, up to ten records. If set to true, the operation queries the most recent active report from all completed historical epochs, returning at most one record without the ten-week limit. Only true or false is accepted. If a string is passed, it must strictly use the lowercase characters true or false. Other values return InvalidParameter.LatestOnly. This operation does not support paging
parameters.help_zh: 是否只返回最近一条可用周期报告。省略或为 false 时，返回最近十个已结束的北京时间自然周范围内的可用报告，最多十条；为 true 时，从所有已结束历史周期中查询最近一条可用报告，最多一条，不受十周范围限制。只接受 true 或 false；使用字符串传值时须严格使用小写 true 或 false，其他值返回 InvalidParameter.LatestOnly。本接口不支持分页
parameters.name: latest_only

schema.description_en: The successful response, which contains the request ID and query results
schema.description_zh: 成功响应，包含本次请求标识与查询结果

Data.description_en: The query result of the periodic report list, which contains the Reports array. The array is empty if no available reports exist
Data.description_zh: 周期报告列表查询结果，包含 Reports 数组；没有可用报告时数组为空

Reports.description_en: The available report records sorted by period from newest to oldest. By default, up to ten records are returned. If LatestOnly is set to true, at most one record is returned. The array is empty if no reports exist. A single natural week may have multiple report records. Use ReportId to distinguish them. The list does not contain download URLs. The actual download status is subject to the result of GetAiReport
Reports.description_zh: 按周期从新到旧排列的可用报告记录。默认最多十条，LatestOnly 为 true 时最多一条；没有报告时为空数组。同一自然周可有多个报告记录，请以 ReportId 区分。列表不包含下载地址，实际下载状态以 GetAiReport 为准

PeriodEnd.description_en: The end time of the natural week to which the report belongs, exclusive. The natural week ends at 00:00:00 on the following Monday in UTC+8 (Asia/Shanghai). This field is transformed to UTC RFC 3339 format and ends with Z. The example corresponds to 00:00:00 on Monday, November 9, 2026, UTC+8
PeriodEnd.description_zh: 报告所属自然周的结束时间，不包含此时刻。结束于下一周周一北京时间（Asia/Shanghai）00:00:00；本字段转换为 UTC RFC 3339 格式输出，以 Z 结尾。示例对应北京时间 2026 年 11 月 9 日周一 00:00:00

PeriodStart.description_en: The start time of the natural week to which the report belongs, inclusive. The natural week is calculated based on UTC+8 (Asia/Shanghai) and starts at 00:00:00 on Monday. This field is transformed to UTC RFC 3339 format and ends with Z. The example corresponds to 00:00:00 on Monday, November 2, 2026, UTC+8
PeriodStart.description_zh: 报告所属自然周的开始时间，包含此时刻。自然周按北京时间（Asia/Shanghai）计算，开始于周一 00:00:00；本字段转换为 UTC RFC 3339 格式输出，以 Z 结尾。示例对应北京时间 2026 年 11 月 2 日周一 00:00:00

ProductCode.description_en: The product code of the data product to which the report belongs. This is consistent with the ProductCode of the current request
ProductCode.description_zh: 该报告所属的数据产品商品编码，与本次请求的 ProductCode 一致

ReportId.description_en: The unique ID of the periodic report. Pass this value as the reportId parameter to GetAiReport to query the current status of the report and obtain the download URL when it is available
ReportId.description_zh: 周期报告的唯一编号。将此值作为 GetAiReport 的 reportId 参数，可查询该报告的当前状态，并在可用时获取下载地址

RequestId.description_en: The unique identity of the request, which is used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting. Provide this ID when troubleshooting exceptions
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于链路追踪和问题排查；排查异常时请提供此编号
